audit_items.proof_trace: All four public liquidation entry points (`liquidate`, `liquidate_as_coin`, `liquidate_adl_borrow`, `liquidate_adl_deposit`) call `pre_liquidation_check`, which invokes `app.ensure_has_permission(object::id(cap), permission)` (app.move:L159-170). That function asserts both whitelist membership (`whitelist.contains(&id)`) and the specific permission bit is set (`(permission & mask) != 0`). Cap creation is restricted to `AdminCap`-gated `mint_new_whitelist`; new caps default to `permission = 0` and require explicit `update_permission` with `AdminCap` to grant any rights.
